tracks.usage: Main gameplay loop for normal turns, dice, resources, building, and trade
tracks.prompt: Original instrumental seamless-loop background track for a friendly island strategy board game. Players study a colorful hex island, roll dice, gain resources, build roads and settlements, and plan trades. Use a warm handcrafted maritime chamber palette: nylon guitar, muted mandolin, soft marimba, gentle pizzicato strings, warm cello, sparse handpan, and brushed frame drum. Thoughtful, sunlit, quietly satisfying, and highly replayable with plenty of space between phrases. 88 BPM, warm modal-major harmony, restrained bass and transients, no dramatic rise or ending resolution. No vocals, pirate music, tropical cliché, trailer build, casino energy, recognizable melody, or sound effects.
